rationale: #0 AdvanceNonce. #1 Jupiter route_v2: #1.1 Transfer 70,881,721 USDC from 2Em7tDfz... (owner CGgM...) into the route; ... #1.9 TransferChecked 70,883,578 USDC back into 2Em7tDfz.... Intermediate legs move cbBTC and WBTC between other parties (#1.2, #1.4, #1.5, #1.8). Net for CGgM...: +1,857 raw USDC and -7,559 lamports, which is exactly the network fee. A circular USDC -> cbBTC -> WBTC -> USDC route; the wallet's net input is nothing but the fee. Amount convention: when the same mint goes out and comes back inside one action, the action records the net.
sources: Jupiter v6 (JUP6LkbZ...); instruction names identified by the Anchor discriminator sha256('global:<name>')[0..8]
